title: 实时聊天机器人恋爱诈骗阶段检测
summary: 该研究开发了一个基于Line Messaging API的聊天机器人，利用大语言模型实时检测恋爱诈骗，并依据社会科学七阶段理论对诈骗阶段进行分类，同时提供阶段解释和防范建议，具有实际应用价值。
summary_en: This study develops a chatbot using the Line Messaging API to detect romance scams in real-time via large language models. Based on seven-stage social science theory, it classifies scam stages and provides explanations and prevention advice, offering practical real-world application value.
